{{Quote|If you have any more problems, please call an actual doctor to assist you.|[[Hologram/Legends|Hologram]] of TB-2, after diagnosing [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta the Huttlet]]|audio=TB2-TCWf.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
'''TB-2''' was a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]] stationed as a [[Medic/Legends|medic]] aboard the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:Wolffe_recovers.png|thumb|left|200px|TB-2 tends to Commander Wolffe aboard the ''Twilight''.]]
After the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B]] [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] named TB-2 was activated by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his new [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to diagnose the [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]] [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta's]] failing health. Sometime later, TB-2 was uploaded into a real 2-1B surgical droid body and remained aboard the ''Twilight''.

Following the rescue of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]], [[Sinker/Legends|Sgt. Sinker]], and [[Boost/Legends|Boost]] after the [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|Battle of Abregado]], TB-2 aided the injured [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], stabilizing them for transport to a [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|Republic medical frigate]].

During the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], TB-2 was stationed in the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']]. He helped cure the injured [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], who was wounded during the attempt to break the blockade of the planet.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:AhsokaAttendsToRotto-TCWf.png|thumb|right|200px|TB-2's hologram form aboard the ''Twilight''.]]
TB-2 is voiced by [[Tim Brock]], the voice [[Actor/Legends|actor]] after whom the droid is named. Brock was also one of the leading texture artists for the show.
